name: happy_chat
description: HappyChat - 类微信/QQ 点对点聊天应用

scripts.dev: concurrently -n tunnel,backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run tunnel" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
